# GitHub labels

| Label | Color | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `spec` | `#1D76DB` | Spec PR awaiting Bucket review |
| `spec-approved` | `#0E8A16` | Spec approved by Bucket |
| `new` | — | Raw idea or bug; nobody works on it |
| `grooming` | — | Bibhu and the CTO shape it to the template; CPO for product questions |
| `agent-ready` | — | Any developer agent picks the top issue; Where says the area |
| `in-progress` | `#0052CC` | Task claimed and in progress |
| `needs-bucket` | `#B60205` | Bucket review required for money, wallet or DB/migration work |
| `blocked` | `#E4E669` | Retry cap hit or the issue is wrong; back to grooming |

`new`, `grooming` and `agent-ready` are documented here only. This change does not create, rename or delete labels, so those three have no color yet.

Do not route new work with `ready:backend`, `ready:frontend` or `ready:system`. Frontend Dev and Backend Dev are retired.
